data.body: CHECKPOINT U6 (loop, 2026-06-04): review-gate summary check BUILT + committed @1b4d283a66. scripts/ci/review-gate.sh (single script runs coverage-invariant + dangling INLINE, single mode-of-truth DSO_REVIEW_GATE_MODE propagated to both sub-checks, preconditions mapped via precondition-gate.sh; NOT a needs/if:failure aggregation -> cannot be greened by a skipped upstream job; DD1/DD2/DD4/DD5) + .github/workflows/review-gate.yml (warn mode, runs on EVERY base==main PR, no code_changed skip, fetch-depth 0 + ast-grep install + ledger cache). test-review-gate-summary.sh 8/8 (named distinctly from the existing local commit-review-gate HOOK test). actionlint+shellcheck clean. DD5 boundary with assert-review-liveness documented in header (complementary: per-PR review PRESENCE vs per-SHA COVERAGE; not subsumed). DD7 = NO-OP: plugin.json already in review-gate-allowlist.conf (KEEP = leave it). Bounded retry inherited from coverage sub-check (7b77 CF-6). STATUS: U1-U6 = the architectural core, COMPLETE warn-first. REMAINING for closure: U7 = DD8/bug 4ba5 (merge-commit net-diff disambiguation in build-integration-diff.sh: genuinely-empty vs mis-computed-empty so the empty-net-diff fail-closed contract does not false-trip a merge commit). NEXT: drive U1-U6 to main via two-tier flow (live-validates review-gate.yml on the staged->main PR2 = E3), then DD8, then completion-verifier + close.
